Health.summary: New research is investigating a potential link between high sugar consumption during childhood and an increased risk of developing anxiety in adulthood. This study highlights the long-term impacts of early dietary habits on mental health.
key_points: Research links childhood sugar intake to adult anxiety.
Investigates potential increased risk.
Highlights long-term impact of early diet on mental health.
